strict_acceptance: CROP_ELIGIBLE with explicit final crop instruction
rules: Each sourcing-ready material/component must render in the final Excel as one bead/item only.
Where a source image contains multiple separated items, the workbook generation step must crop to the explicit single target before embedding.
The source URL must remain in the row for traceability.
No-direct-purchase parents/placeholders do not require an image.
Gold-tone hardware and non-elastic stringing remain outside sourcing-ready scope until their upstream material/structure decisions are made.
special_notes: 发晶（未细分） remains taxonomy-only and is not user-visible as a selectable sourcing item; final user-facing list uses 金发晶 and 黑发晶 only.
Crop-ready status is not permission to display the original multi-item image unchanged. Final Excel must embed the single-item crop.
Third-party images are sourcing-recognition references only, not project-owned marketing assets or proof of material identity.
excel_image_rule: During workbook generation, execute every crop instruction and embed only the single-item derivative.
